name: Form Kernel Plant (Web)
implementation_notes: REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): the Kernel Plant Detail grid is now DYNAMIC -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() now exist on FormKernelPlant.php, exactly mirroring FormDepricarping's Depricarping Detail grid (screen-059, fixed moments earlier)/FormPressing's Pressing Detail grid (screen-058)/FormThreshing's Threshing Detail grid (screen-057) and FormCagesTrack's Cages Tipped Time grid. Grid starts empty on create mode (was: built from KernelPlantRecordService::canonicalTimeSlots() into 24 rows on mount); edit mode still loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 9 reading-column inputs per row are genuinely editable number/text fields, never disabled -- Kernel Plant has no computed detail-grid fields (for comparison, Form Cages Track Web's Total Cages/Cages Remain, formerly disabled inputs, have been rendered as plain text since 2026-10-04), so the 'no disabled web inputs' rule applies with zero exceptions in this screen (enforced statically by tests/Feature/Livewire/WebFormNoDisabledFieldTest.php); Downtime (Mins) is a plain number input and Findings a plain text input, both freely editable like the other 7 numeric columns -- a row simply counts as filled when EITHER is set, same as any other reading column

Target Operasional table queried directly by FormKernelPlant::render(), never sent as part of the create/update payload; renders 3 columns (Equipment / Parameter, Target Benchmark, Corrective Action Plan) matching Threshing's/Pressing's shape, NOT Depricarping's 4-column shape -- UNTOUCHED by this revision
Route /data/kernel-plant/create registered BEFORE /data/kernel-plant/{id} (screen-056) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}

checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormDepricarping's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By, unlike Form Weighbridge/Grading Web which only have Acknowledged)

Ran the full backend Pest suite as the final step of this 6-screen pass (Kernel Plant is the LAST of the 4 new stations to receive this fix): 1299/1299 passing (up from the baseline of 1287/1287 before this fix), confirming zero regressions across Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant and every other station.
Detail upsert (insert/update/delete) dijalankan dalam DB transaction agar konsisten, sama pola dengan Depricarping/Pressing/Threshing/Cages Track/Grading Detail.

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): KernelPlantRecordService::create() memanggil assertPeriodOpenForWrite('kernel-plant', station->business_unit_id, date) setelah validasi & resolve station dan sebelum penulisan pertama; update() memanggilnya dua kali (tanggal lama record dan tanggal baru dari body) setelah findOrFail/cek akses/validasi — jadi memindahkan record keluar dari periode tertutup juga ditolak. Penolakan = PeriodClosedException 422 PERIOD_CLOSED dengan salah satu dari 4 pesan (belum ada periode / masih Draft / sudah ditutup / di luar rentang + rentang yang berlaku), nol baris tersimpan. FormKernelPlant::save() menangkap HttpException dan menampilkan pesannya sebagai alert halaman ($generalError). Test yang menutupnya: tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan + cek statis ke-18 service) dan tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php (end-to-end via Sterilizer); test per-layar (tests/Unit/Services/KernelPlantRecordServiceTest.php, tests/Feature/Api/FormKernelPlantTest.php, tests/Feature/Livewire/FormKernelPlantTest.php) membuka periode Terbuka sebagai prasyarat via openPeriodFor()/openPeriodForStation(). test_results tidak diubah (suite tidak dijalankan ulang untuk sinkronisasi ini).

REVISI v4 (2026-10-03, uji ditambahkan — kode produksi tidak diubah): tests/Feature/Api/FormKernelPlantTest.php kini punya 3 uji HTTP kunci periode per-stasiun yang menutup celah 'penolakan kunci periode hanya diuji end-to-end via Sterilizer': (1) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat POST bertanggal di periode tertutup, tanpa menyimpan satu baris pun'; (2) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat PATCH record yang tanggal lamanya di periode tertutup walau tanggal barunya di periode terbuka, dan record tidak berubah'; (3) 'kunci periode: menerima 201 saat POST tepat pada tanggal awal dan tanggal akhir periode terbuka (inklusif)'. Ketiganya mengganti periode prasyarat dengan sepasang periode tertutup + terbuka lewat helper replacePrerequisiteWithClosedAndOpenPeriods() di tests/Pest.php. Berkas kini 21 uji, semuanya hijau (test_results.integration diperbarui).
